note: Stablecoin-based global payments app (Sling Money, now Morse Money: sling.money redirects to morsemoney.com) of Avian Labs, founded in 2022 by Mike Hudack and Simon Amor (ex-Monzo), London. 'Sling Money said it previously raised $5 million in a seed round led by Ribbit Capital' and the $15M Series A 'was led by Union Square Ventures, Ribbit Capital, and Slow Ventures' (The Block, 2024-08-14), so the seed graduated on a named Series A. No source dates the seed; the entry year 2022 is the UK register's: Avian Labs Ltd came under its US parent Avian Labs Inc on 2022-07-13 and adopted new articles on 2022-07-28 (Companies House 13941760), the paperwork of a closing, and the company was incorporated only in February 2022.

funding_rounds.lead: Union Square Ventures, Ribbit Capital and Slow Ventures
